message: My export has been stuck at 90% since yesterday. Is this a known issue? And can I get a refund for this month if it isn't fixed by Friday?
draft: Hi Lucy, sorry about this. Yes, we're aware of the export issue and a fix is rolling out today. You should see it complete within a few hours.

asks.q: And can I get a refund for this month if it isn't fixed by Friday?

message: How do I change the email address on my account?
draft: Go to Settings, then Profile, and click Edit next to your email. You'll get a confirmation link at the new address.

asks.q: How do I change the email address on my account?

note: A how-to question with a full answer.

message: I was charged twice on the 4th. Which of the two charges will be reversed, and when will I see the money back?
draft: Apologies for the double charge, Omar. I've raised this with billing and they're looking into the reversal.

asks.q: Which of the two charges will be reversed, and when will I see the money back?

note: Acknowledged, but neither which nor when is answered.

message: Just wanted to say the new dashboard is a big improvement. The load time used to be painful and now it's instant. Whoever worked on it, please pass on my thanks. No action needed from you, I just don't send enough nice emails.
draft: That made our day, thank you. I'll pass it along to the team.
note: 'Please pass on my thanks' is a courtesy, and the sender says no action is needed.

message: Please reset my password and send me a temporary one by email.
draft: For security we can't send passwords by email, but I've sent a reset link to your address. It's valid for one hour.

asks.q: Please reset my password and send me a temporary one by email.

note: The request is declined and an alternative is given. That addresses it.
